law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking prohibited in specified places (1)(h)
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Between a safety zone and the adjacent curb or within 30 feet of points on the curb immediately opposite the ends of a safety zone.

activation_conditions: a safety zone exists on the highway
the subject stops, stands or parks between it and the adjacent curb, or within 30 feet of the curb points opposite its ends
exceptions: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
in compliance with the directions of a police officer or an official traffic-control device
residue: the 'points on the curb immediately opposite the ends' are a geometric construction from the zone's extent
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: judged for every instant at rest in the prohibited band
